name: Aviato
summary: Company, funding, investor and people data, contact info and search through the Aviato data engine.

api_key.description: an Aviato API key (data.aviato.co dashboard > Teams > API Keys)

notes: Credit-based; billing.balance shows the team balance. Previews and 404s cost nothing; most enrich calls cost a credit per successful lookup.
Company endpoints accept any one identifier (id, website, linkedinURL, crunchbaseID...). List endpoints need perPage and page.
Search endpoints take the Aviato DSL; person.simple_search is the flat-parameter alternative. At most 15 searches run concurrently.
